title: [The Lucky Nirisaka]
description: Weathered jadewood planks comprise the vast majority of the ship and its deck, evidence of a ship long at sea; affixed to the prow, however, arches a polished ghostwood figurehead of a one-eyed flounder, its ugly ghost white countenance a contrast to its dark green surroundings.  A smaller, more whimsical version of the nirisaka is carved into a sign dangling above a side entrance of the ship's spacious cabin.
